blocks.text: With Salomé Richard, Aurélia Petit, Anne Coesens
Courtesy of Rai Cinema International Distribution

Anne, Hélène and Suzanne each take a season as hut master. As the landscape morphs throughout the year, a vivid portrait of these women emerges; each resolute in their independence and comfort in this self-imposed solitude. With its gentle observations of natural and human interactions, Manon Coubia’s award-winning debut is a sublime offering for harried urban dwellers.
Contains scenes of nudity and sex.

blocks.text: Infused with gentle humour and profound humanity, Sompot Chidgasornpongse’s fiction debut presents a serene passage through family, faith and the cycles of life.
Shaped by the tidal rhythms of British Columbia’s oyster farms, this richly cinematic documentary, shot on 35mm, exists where labour, scientific inquiry and the living world meet.
German filmmaker Angela’s Schanelec continues to mine the vagaries of the human psyche with this masterful study of a relationship in freefall.
